learn.picture.body: Cold, still mornings hold smoke near the ground; in the afternoon it is often half as bad, so the same walk at 3 pm means much less smoke in your lungs.

learn.decide.title: How we decide
learn.decide.rules: Fixed rules decide Go, Go with care and Avoid from the air band, each person's care group and how hard the activity is. Our AI assistant only writes the words; it can't change a verdict or a time.
learn.decide.trips: School and office trips are never "skip it": we switch to the safest way there, shared rides first (metro, school bus, carpool), then the car.
learn.decide.winter: From November to February in Delhi NCR, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, we check one band stricter for extra-care members, because model data can read low during smog.
learn.numbers.title: About our numbers
learn.numbers.factors: CO₂ per person per km, by travel mode (kg)
learn.numbers.estimates: These factors are estimates from published Indian transport studies (ICCT, DMRC) and are still being checked; we always round and say "about".
privacy.title: Your data, in plain words
privacy.store.title: What we store
privacy.store.body: Your name, age group, routine, travel, language and your family's home area (rounded to about 1 km). Health ticks only if you choose, and only you see them by default.
privacy.dont.title: What we don't
privacy.dont.body: Your exact location, your chats with Breezy, photos.
privacy.adults.title: Adults only
privacy.adults.body: BreatheWell accounts are for adults 18+. A parent or guardian can add a child or teen and provides their details on the child's behalf; health ticks are optional; the guardian or the admin can delete the child's profile at any time, which erases it at once.
privacy.gemini.title: Google Gemini
privacy.gemini.body: Your family's tags and routines, without names or health details, are sent to Google Gemini (free tier) to write your plan; children and teens you add are sent only as "a child under 13" or "a teen". Questions you type to Breezy are sent to Gemini, which may use them to improve its service. Don't type private details. Kid cards are written from checked templates; an item an adult adds with the assistant is AI-written, confirmed by that adult and checked before it shows on the card.
privacy.location.title: Your location
privacy.location.body: Your browser sends your location to BigDataCloud to find the place name, and the rounded location goes to Open-Meteo for the air data. Neither gets your name.
privacy.delete.title: Deleting your data
privacy.delete.body: Profile → Delete my account erases everything at once.
privacy.sources.title: Data sources and contact
privacy.sources.body: Air: Open-Meteo (CAMS model), on India's CPCB scale. Place names: BigDataCloud. Questions about your data: open an issue on BreatheWell's GitHub repository (the Issues tab), or delete your data yourself at any time from Profile.
privacy.who.title: Who sees what
privacy.who.family.what: Name, age group, routine, travel, verdicts, plan, checklist, and the tag "Extra care" or "Sensitive".
privacy.who.you.what: The names of your health conditions (you can share them with the admin or the whole family).
privacy.who.adults.what: Children's and teens' details and kid cards. The guardian who added them and the admin can edit or delete them.
privacy.who.admin.what: The join code and QR, and editing the home set-up (everyone can see it).
privacy.keep.title: How long we keep it
privacy.keep.codes.how: Deleted when a new code is made, or a day after they expire
privacy.keep.profile.how: Until you leave the family, are removed, or delete your account
privacy.keep.dependents.how: Until the guardian or admin deletes them, the guardian leaves, or the family is deleted
privacy.keep.chats.how: Not kept on our servers; only in your browser tab
